name: Workflow Use
description: Records or generates deterministic browser workflows and replays them, falling back to an agent when a step breaks.
whatItDoes: Captures a web process once and turns it into a reusable, parameterised workflow that runs faster and cheaper than a free-roaming agent. It is aimed at teams replacing brittle RPA scripts; the project describes itself as early stage.
howItWorks: A browser extension records interactions and a Python package converts them into a workflow file. A CLI can run a workflow directly, run it as a tool filled in from a prompt, or generate a new one from a description. When a recorded step fails, a browser-use agent takes over that step.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Model used for generation and fallback

requirements.name: Node.js and uv
requirements.description: Build the extension and the Python environment

install: cd extension && npm install && npm run build
